::: {.about-bio}
I am a bioinformatics researcher and software engineer working at the intersection of structural biology, artificial intelligence, and FAIR data. I hold a Ph.D. in Bioinformatics and a diploma in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the Aristotle University of Thessaloniki.
:::
